title: Capability
description: What an adapter can do, named by function and never by product. Lowercase dotted segments, at least two: the first names the area, the rest narrow it (code.edit, vcs.pullrequest, channel.chat, workspace.isolated). Processes, frames and anchors reference capabilities only; mapping a capability to a concrete adapter is configuration.

pattern.title: CapabilityPattern
pattern.description: A capability that may be narrowed by a qualifier after a colon (vcs.push:protected) and may use * as a whole segment or qualifier (net.egress:*, code.*). Used where a set of capabilities is denied or anchored.
